patterns.path: absolute local filesystem paths under a user, home, or mounted-volume directory root, replaced with a placeholder token (trailing real filename kept when present)
patterns.host: the two internal machine nicknames used for these runs, replaced with a generic placeholder nickname (an underscore variant is used when the original appeared inside a snake_case identifier)
patterns.ip: private-range IPv4 addresses, replaced with a placeholder token
patterns.s3: object-storage bucket URIs, replaced with a placeholder token
patterns.ssh: remote-shell URLs, replaced with a placeholder token
patterns.git: SSH-style git remote URLs, replaced with a placeholder token
